name: Kechara Soup Kitchen
summary: Fights hunger and poverty in Malaysia by distributing food and helping the homeless, urban poor and Orang Asli move towards self-sufficiency.
programmes: Food bank for families and partner charities
Education support for Orang Asli children
Dual food distribution kitchen and empowerment centre in Jalan Barat (opened 2026)
beneficiaries: Homeless people, urban poor families and Orang Asli communities

organisation.leadership: Henry Ooi (President); Li Kim (Vice President); Su Ming (Secretary); Beng Kooi (Treasurer); Justin Cheah Kok Leong (General Manager, per The Star Aug 2026)
organisation.accounts: Annual reports 2021-2025 and financial reports 2018-2025 public at https://www.kecharasoupkitchen.com/reports (2025 financial report: https://cdn.sanity.io/files/qmiz5sgj/production/a8763413908ca8d82da1659f2635ecc5227e13b1.pdf); audit status not stated

contact.address: 17, Jalan Barat, Off Jalan Imbi, 55100 Kuala Lumpur

live.note: YouTube and TikTok channels linked from site (https://www.youtube.com/@kecharasoupkitchen2038); video count and live streaming not verified

donationsToday: Online one-time or monthly donation, in-kind donations, campaigns (Feed a Family, Host a Fundraiser, Run For a Reason); 44(6) receipt for RM50 and above
